Frequently Asked Questions (Shopify Fee Calc)

At what monthly revenue should I upgrade from Shopify Basic to Shopify Grow?

On Shopify Payments, the card rate drops by 0.2% (2.9% to 2.7%) while the monthly plan rises by $50–$66/mo—meaning Grow breaks even on processing fees around $25,000–$33,000/month in revenue.

Does Shopify charge a marketplace commission like Etsy or Amazon?

No. When using Shopify Payments, Shopify charges 0% marketplace referral commission—you only pay the flat monthly subscription and standard credit card processing.
